article_content: In a Florida movie theater, Curtis Reeves, a 71-year-old retired police officer, fatally shot Chad Oulson, a 43-year-old ex-Navy petty officer. Reeves claimed self-defense, saying that Oulson had snuck a cell phone into the theater, threw popcorn at Reeves, and argued with him, followed by Reeves shooting Oulson while Oulson's wife and another person were also injured by the gunshot. The incident has provoked debates on permit policies and safety protocol in theaters, and Reeves now faces second-degree murder charges.
